explanation: The AI response only correctly identified 2 out of the 9 expected MPs: Stephen Farry and Carla Lockhart (although it misattributed Carla Lockhart to the Green Party instead of the DUP). It missed Gregory Campbell, Gavin Robinson, Jim Shannon, Sammy Wilson, Caroline Lucas, Ben Lake, and Liz Saville Roberts. Additionally, it hallucinated several non-existent DUP/Independent MP names.
